nodes.text: An index card in a plastic sleeve, typed.
OKIMOTO, JUNE · programmer · Dallas, TX · hired 2003.
Prior: interviewed Koa Works, Honolulu, 1991. Not hired. Someone has pencilled after it: their loss.
Declared at hire under the personal-property clause: one boxed game, WHAT LIES BEYOND. Condition, in her own handwriting: opened.
Interview notes, one line: father presumed dead several weeks, early seventies. See attached.
Nothing is attached. The staple holes are there. In the corner, the interviewer's initials: D.D.
